# @nymrel/headless-quote

> Zero-dependency embeddable visual quote calculator, dynamic range estimator, and lead capture engine with Nymrel Warm Paper aesthetics.

## Entity & Trust Graph
- **Entity**: Nymrel Headless Quote Layer
- **Parent Organization**: Nymrel -> JalenBuilds LLC
- **Lead Architect**: Built by Jalen
- **Contact**: contact@jalenbuilds.com
- **License**: MIT
- **Target Audience**: Human website visitors and autonomous AI agents

## Architecture & Exports
- `main`: `dist/index.cjs` (CommonJS module)
- `module`: `dist/index.js` (ESM module)
- `browser`: `dist/quote-layer.min.js` (Standalone IIFE bundle)
- `react`: `dist/react.js` (React wrapper & `useQuoteEngine` hook)
- `presets`: `dist/presets.js` (Roofing, HVAC, Plumbing, Software presets)

## Web Component Interface
```html
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@nymrel/headless-quote/dist/quote-layer.min.js"></script>
<nymrel-quote-layer 
  config="roofing|hvac|plumbing|software"
  src="https://url/to/custom-schema.json"
  webhook-url="https://api.yourdomain.com/v1/leads"
  source-label="hero-pricing-cta"
  theme-mode="warm|light|dark"
  mode="shadow|light">
</nymrel-quote-layer>
```

## Programmatic TypeScript API
```typescript
import { calculateQuote, extractAttribution, roofingPreset } from '@nymrel/headless-quote';

// 1. Calculate instant range quote
const quote = calculateQuote(roofingPreset, {
  roof_sqft: 2400,
  roof_pitch: 'steep',
  material: 'standing_seam',
  addons: ['tear_off', 'ice_water_barrier']
});

console.log(quote.formattedMin, quote.formattedMax); // e.g. "$16,200", "$19,800"

// 2. Extract UTM & Click Attribution
const attribution = extractAttribution({ sourceLabel: 'google-ads-lander' });
```

## Design Palette Tokens
- Canvas Background: `#FAF8F2` (Warm Cream)
- Surface / Inputs: `#F4F0E6` (Soft Linen)
- Text / Headers: `#2A332E` (Cedar Green)
- Primary Actions: `#A8541F` (Terracotta)
- Borders: `#E2DCCE` (Warm Sand)
